sections.title: Cyber Security
sections.subtitle: End-to-end security, from code to AI, with Linkfields products and specialist services.

sections.heading: Connect security controls with delivery evidence
sections.body:
Bring offensive testing, cloud and identity reviews, control governance and security operations into a defined security scope. Linkfields software adds external exposure validation, code and supply-chain analysis, and AI gateway controls.

Begin with the assets, risks and evidence your organisation needs to address. [Discuss an assessment, controls or operations engagement](#get-in-touch). This form is for business enquiries, not active-incident reporting.

sections.heading: What we deliver
sections.description: Choose the specialist service that fits your next decision.

items.title: AI security & GRC
items.description: Define AI and control governance, regulatory requirements and evidence needs. Connect control mapping with security awareness, staff education and phishing drills.

items.title: Cloud security & IAM
items.description: Review cloud and identity architecture, network controls and firewalls. Establish access and security baselines against the requirements agreed for your environment.

items.title: Exposure validation & AppSec
items.description: Validate the external attack surface and examine code and software supply chains. Scope offensive testing for AI, LLMs and web applications.

items.title: Security operations
items.description: Connect monitoring, investigation and response using tools such as Splunk SIEM, Qualys and Rapid7. Agree detection, triage and containment responsibilities, coverage and escalation scope.

sections.heading: Validate exposure. Strengthen *assurance evidence*.
sections.description: Cyber Security contributes exposure validation, control mapping, remediation evidence and code assurance. Regulatory scope and success criteria are agreed with your control owners.

plays.title: Regulated Cyber Readiness
plays.trigger: Control owners need repeatable evidence for the requirements in scope.
plays.outcome: Start with an exposure and control-evidence baseline. Map findings to controls and record remediation and revalidation evidence.

plays.title: AI Code Assurance
plays.trigger: AI-written changes introduce code and software supply-chain risk.
plays.outcome: Start with a repo-to-release assurance-gate map. Combine VectorX findings with functional release evidence and agreed security acceptance criteria.

sections.heading: Security software and *specialist services*
sections.description: Use Linkfields software on its own or alongside specialist services.

items.title: VajraX
items.description: AI-powered exposure validation of the external attack surface. Connect findings and validation with remediation priorities agreed for the assets in scope.

items.title: VectorX
items.description: Code scanning and supply-chain analysis, repo to release. Use findings as part of security review and CI/CD assurance decisions.

items.title: AI Governance
items.description: An AI gateway for guardrails, cost monitoring and tracing. The Linkfields offering is built on Portkey and Opik; scope the configuration, deployment and support responsibilities for your environment.

items.title: Security delivery accelerators
items.description: Regulatory Readiness & Control Mapping, Continuous Compliance & Audit Evidence, and Cloud, AI & Identity Security Baselines support assessment and control work.

sections.noteLabel: Software and services are separate choices
sections.note: Products are available by licence, subscription or SaaS, with or without a Linkfields services engagement. Agree deployment, data handling and integration requirements for the selected offering.

sections.heading: From assessment to continuous evidence
sections.description: Illustrative engagement pattern: agree scope, owners and acceptance criteria before delivery.

items.title: Scope and assess
items.description: Agree assets, control requirements, access and testing boundaries. Define evidence needs and the responsibilities of each team.

items.title: Validate and remediate
items.description: Validate findings, prioritise remediation with owners and record changes. Recheck the exposures or controls addressed.

items.title: Monitor and evidence
items.description: Choose ongoing controls or operations where needed. Agree coverage, integrations, escalation and review cadence in the service scope.

sections.note: Agree asset scope, validated findings, mapped controls, remediation owners and revalidation evidence. Confirm monitoring coverage, integrations and escalation; an assessment is not compliance certification.
